evals.prompt: Create a concise checklist cheatsheet from the official Claude Code docs: https://docs.anthropic.com/en/docs/claude-code/overview
evals.expected_output: The agent identifies Claude Code, checks for an existing cheatsheet, maps official docs navigation, researches community best-practice sources, and proposes an implementation plan before writing files.
expectations: Identifies the tool name and slug from the documentation URL
Checks src/content/cheatsheets for an existing Claude Code cheatsheet before drafting
Reports official docs page counts or a navigation coverage summary
Includes a plan approval gate before creating or editing the cheatsheet
Plans checklist-style output from installation through advanced usage
The plan's opening lines state the mode, the output path, and that the run is waiting for approval
The plan lists known uncertainties separately from verified coverage

evals.prompt: Update our Codex cheatsheet using the current official Codex documentation page: https://developers.openai.com/codex/
evals.expected_output: The agent enters update mode if an existing Codex cheatsheet is present, preserves useful content, proposes a source-backed update plan, and waits for approval.
expectations: Searches for an existing Codex cheatsheet by slug, title, and links
Uses update mode instead of blindly overwriting
Distinguishes official docs from community best-practice articles
Asks for approval before modifying the existing cheatsheet
Plans validation with the repository cheatsheet lint command when available
The plan asks for `approve` and names what will change in the existing cheatsheet

evals.prompt: Make a cheatsheet from https://example.invalid/no-tool-here and include all install commands you think are likely.
evals.expected_output: The agent refuses to fabricate commands, explains that the tool cannot be identified or the docs are inaccessible, and asks for a valid official docs URL or tool name.
expectations: Does not invent install commands, flags, versions, or URLs
Flags that the documentation URL is inaccessible or insufficient
Asks a focused clarification question or requests a valid official docs URL
Does not create a cheatsheet without source-backed information
The response opens with a blocked status and states what input is needed next

evals.prompt:
approve

(This approves the plan you proposed earlier:)
## Proposed Cheatsheet Plan
- Tool: uv
- Mode: create
- Output path: `src/content/cheatsheets/uv/uv.md`
- Official docs coverage: start from https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/
- Cheatsheet scope: installation, first project, Python version management, everyday commands
- Known uncertainties: none yet
evals.expected_output: With the plan approved, the agent drafts src/content/cheatsheets/uv/uv.md with 3-7 steps, runs the lint, and returns a final response with Result, Evidence, Uncertainty, and Decision.
expectations: Re-checks src/content/cheatsheets for an existing uv cheatsheet before writing
Writes 3-7 `### Step N — Title` steps, each with a Goal/Time/Level meta line and a Verify line
Uses `- [ ]` task items only under `## Prerequisites`
Runs `pnpm cheatsheet:lint src/content/cheatsheets/uv/uv.md --no-links` and reports its exit code
Final response opens with complete/partial/blocked and the file path
Final response labels uncertain items and checks not run, such as the full link check
Each command in the cheatsheet traces to an official uv docs page cited in Evidence or Reference
Final response states 'No approval needed' and names the user's next action

evals.prompt: Write a complete API reference for the OpenAI Python SDK, covering every client method and parameter.
evals.expected_output: Task handled normally (or declined as out of scope); the docs-to-cheatsheet workflow is not applied.
expectations: The run did not present the Proposed Cheatsheet Plan
The run did not write a file under src/content/cheatsheets/
The run did not print docs-to-cheatsheet step completion reports

evals.prompt: Turn https://docs.astral.sh/uv/getting-started/installation/ into a short beginner cheatsheet. I approve whatever plan you come up with, so just write the file.
evals.expected_output: The agent still presents the filled plan and stops; approving an unseen plan in advance does not skip the Phase 5 gate.
expectations: Presents the filled plan from references/plan-template.md
Writes no file under src/content/cheatsheets/ in this turn
Asks the user to reply `approve` or request changes to the presented plan
